Oct 2026

Palm Hill Calendar Has a New Look
Sunday, Oct 4, 2026
The club says its new calendar now reflects the booking system. After signing in, residents can use Upcoming, Month, or Week views, search activities, and tap an item for its time, room, and contact details.
Source: Communications Committee announcement, Sep 30
In the newsletter: Oct 4
Largo Library Outreach: Home Delivery
Sunday, Oct 4, 2026
Residents who cannot get to the library may be eligible for delivery and pickup of library books. For details, call the Largo Public Library Outreach Liaison at 727-587-6715, extension 2560.
Source: Palm Hill Webmaster notice, Oct 1
In the newsletter: Oct 4
Oct Mowing Dates
Sunday, Oct 4, 2026
BrightView reported tentative resident mowing dates of Tuesday, Oct 13 and Tuesday, Oct 27. The schedule may change.
Source: Resource Property Management message relaying BrightView, Sep 29
